name: tudeco
description: Monorepo de Tudeco: API (back) + dashboard Next.js (front)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w back" "npm run dev -w front"
scripts.test: npm run test -w back && npm run test -w front
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w back && npm run typecheck -w front
scripts.build: npm run build -w back && npm run build -w front
